description: Updates an innovation, editable disclosure, Strategy, case relationship or inventor additions asset atomically at its fetched revision. Omitted fields are unchanged; collection fields specify the complete desired state. Innovations and draft disclosures archive/restore separately. Innovation contributors credit people by name without granting access or inviting anyone. Case assets change only related innovations; inaccessible links and preparation history stay. Disclosures support prose, insight selections, illustration descriptions and inventor names; inventor additions, text and drawings. Illustration removal permanently deletes its image. Strategies replace supplied sections and report detached discussions. Requires write consent, editing rights and the full fetched snapshot; inventor changes also require include_inventors. Confidential or archived records refuse content edits. Does not request patent services. Conflicts and uncertain outcomes require readback and reconciliation.

sections.description: Complete desired ordered section collection. Omitted existing IDs are deleted; array order is saved. Preserve every section to keep. Omit this field to leave all sections unchanged.

content.description: Section Markdown; empty clears its body

id.description: Existing section ID from fetch; omit only for a new section
The report:<id> reference returned by search, fetch or create_asset

revision.description: asset.revision from the latest fetch with include_asset: true; stale revisions fail without writes

archived.description: Archive (true) or restore (false). Send alone, at the fetched revision; requires owner or moderator rights.

contributors.description: Complete desired list of contributor display names, stored as plain text without email or account lookup. On update it replaces the fetched list; omitted names are removed, so a name stays unless the user asks to remove it. Credit only: grants no access, sends no invitation and is not inventor or assignment data.

relatedCases.description: Complete desired visible case list from the fetched relations; omitted visible links are removed only with user intent. Inaccessible links and preparation history remain. Links do not copy content or start preparation.

archived.description: Archive or restore separately from content, using the current revision and owner/moderator rights.

illustrations.description: Change illustrations, keyed by an id from data.illustrations of a fetch with include_insights_and_illustrations: true: description replaces the plain-text description, and remove: true removes the illustration and permanently deletes its image, requiring explicit user intent. Omitted illustrations remain unchanged. New illustrations require an upload.

insights.description: Which insights are selected in a generated list, keyed by a list name from context.insights. selected holds the item text of every insight to select, copied from data.insights of a fetch with include_insights_and_illustrations: true; the rest of that list is set aside. A list whose selection is single takes at most one; a list whose selection is none cannot be changed. Omitted lists remain unchanged. Insight text cannot be edited.

inventors.description: Complete desired inventor list. Preserve every existing ID, including when correcting a name, and omit a person only when the user requests removal. Other personal details and assignment records are retained. Read include_inventors: true before editing.

id.description: Existing inventor ID from fetch with include_inventors: true; omit only for a new person

sections.description: Replace only supplied prose sections; omitted sections remain unchanged. Empty text clears a section. Horizontal rules and blockquotes are stored as written; content a section cannot hold fails atomically. Disclosure text left as read keeps its comments and pending changes. LaTeX in $`…`$ inline or in a ```math fenced block is stored as an equation, \ce{…} inside those forms as a chemical formula or reaction, and \chemfig{…} or \smiles{…} inside them as a chemical structure; bare $…$ remains literal text. In a paragraph the write edits, a chemical structure left in place exactly as read usually keeps its stored forms, such as a molfile or CDXML. One whose \chemfig{…} or \smiles{…} changes, one moved elsewhere, and one in a write that reports incomplete mark preservation can keep only what is written. A labelled reference such as "Equation 2" becomes plain text. These losses are not reported individually. Detached discussion anchors and incomplete mark preservation are reported.

relatedInnovations.description: Complete desired visible innovation list from the case snapshot; omitted visible links are removed only with user intent. Each changed innovation requires edit access. Inaccessible links and preparation history remain.

content.description: The complete inventor additions as Markdown; replaces the stored text, empty clears it

illustrations.description: Change drawings, keyed by an id from data.illustrations: description replaces the plain-text description, and remove: true removes the drawing and permanently deletes its image, requiring explicit user intent. Omitted drawings remain unchanged. New drawings require an upload.

name: update_asset

id.description: The report:<id> reference returned by search, fetch or create_asset

detached_threads.description: Comment threads whose anchored text this write removed. They still exist but no longer point at any text; re-anchor or resolve them in the app.

quote.description: The text the thread was anchored on before this write

dropped.description: Markdown the write could not store. Empty when everything was kept.

kind.description: What was dropped: image, footnote, horizontalRule or unsupported

text.description: The markdown as written, shortened when long

marks_incomplete.description: The write was too large to match every edited paragraph to its stored one, so some were matched only roughly: their pending changes stay, but comment anchors on the edited text may have come off; those threads are listed as detached. Smaller writes keep them.
